problem: An apple pie in a skillet still reads mostly as a generic pie at thumbnail size; the western theme relies on a small napkin next to it.
fix: Sharpen the western chuckwagon silhouette: a cast-iron skillet with golden cornbread and a cowboy star butter pat, resting on a red paisley bandana on the porch table.

problem: A cow skull violates the bright, kid-friendly mood (no bones/death imagery) and adds a second separate idea next to the cactus.
fix: Keep a single cheerful desert cactus icon: a cluster of prickly pear cactus pads with bright yellow blossoms growing in red desert sand beside a painted southwest clay pot shard.

problem: A folding camp chair is too modern/generic even with fringe and a star brand; its silhouette does not scream Wild West.
fix: Replace with an iconic western camp seat: a wooden cargo barrel topped with a tooled leather saddle cushion and horse blanket stripes.
